chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu Hammam Isma'il ibn Hammam, who said:
I saw al-Rida عليه السلام, and we were with him. We did not perform the Maghrib prayer until the stars appeared. Then he stood and led us in prayer at the door of the house of Ibn Abi Mahmud.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, the Imam being described in the report
key_terms.النُّجُومُ: the stars, whose appearance marks the time mentioned in the narration
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبَ: the Maghrib salat, the sunset prayer under discussion
key_terms.بَابِ: the door or entrance, specifying the location where the prayer was performed
key_terms.دَارِ: the house or residence mentioned in the report
key_terms.فَصَلَّى: he performed salat or led the prayer

ai.seo_question: When does the time of Maghrib salat extend according to a narration from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an instance in which Imam al-Rida عليه السلام delayed the Maghrib salat until the stars had appeared, then led the prayer. It is cited in the context of discussing the time of Maghrib and the later evening prayer, indicating a juristic relevance regarding prayer timing.
